monsters.name: Eustachio
monsters.description:
An apprentice summoner with a flowing moustache. He has funny ideas about honour.

Max HP: ~40      Will: +           AC: +          EV: +++                       
    rF: ...        rC: +..      rPois: .        rNeg: ...       rElec: .        
Threat: Lethal  Class: Natural   Size: Medium    Int: Human     


You have about 53% to hit with your +0 hand axe and 39% to hit with your headbutt.
He has about 69% to hit you.

Attack          Max Damage  
Hit: +0 rapier  12          

He can open doors.
To read a description, press the key listed above. (AdB) indicates damage (the sum of A B-sided dice), (x%) indicates the chance to defeat your Will, and (y) indicates the spell range; shown in red if you are in range.
